coverage.reason: One-time operator maintenance retires only reviewed idle version-1 NPC identities in the current active realm and lets the installed population scheduler create version-2 replacements. Actual isolated PostgreSQL tests cover read-only planning, exact document/realm checks, public/private atomicity, active scouts/attacks and rallies, SERIALIZABLE concurrent-launch phantom protection, idempotent receipts, stale-plan rejection, unchanged player/archive data and cooldowns, and normal replacement. Existing PostgreSQL respawn and selected population emulator tests protect scheduler placement, fresh identities, cooldowns and caps. Fixed reward-rule tests protect the replacement version. No runtime server source, frontend layouts, assets, gameplay reward formulas or deployment policy changes; no additional visual checks are needed. The Master Specification records the explicitly requested one-time refresh exception and the previously verified local balance deployment.
